subject: english
question:
Select the sentence containing the homonym of the highlighted word:

The **dove** flew above the trees with grace.

options.text: She watched the dove as it landed.
A dove perched on the window sill.
He saw the dove headfirst into the challenge.
The diver dove deep into the ocean.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"dove"** is a homonym, meaning it has two different meanings but is spelled and pronounced the same way. (समान उच्चारण और वर्तनी वाले दो अर्थ वाले शब्द) 

 
 
• **Meaning 1:** A type of bird known for its peaceful nature. (कबूतर)
 
• **Example:** The dove perched on the tree branch, looking serene.
 

 
 
• **Meaning 2:** The past tense of "dive," which means to plunge into water or a situation. (पानी में गोता लगाना)
 
• **Example:** The diver dove deep into the ocean to explore the coral reefs.
 
 

 
• In the sentence "The diver dove deep into the ocean," the word "dove" is used as the past tense of "dive," and this matches the homonym usage.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1:** She watched the dove as it landed. (कबूतर को उसने देखा जब वह उतरा।) 

 
 
• This sentence uses "dove" to refer to the bird, which does not match the homonym usage.
 
 

 
• **Option 2:** A dove perched on the window sill. (एक कबूतर खिड़की पर बैठ गया।)

 
 
• This sentence also uses "dove" to refer to the bird, which is not the homonym usage.
 
 

 
• **Option 3:** He saw the dove headfirst into the challenge. (उसने देखा कि उसने चुनौती में सिर के बल गोता लगाया।)

 
 
• While this sentence uses "dove" metaphorically, it does not fit the homonym usage related to "dive." It is a figurative expression.
 
 

60:Taa3,

The correct answer is: **Option 1**.
